tooltips.rowLimit: Empty — all records (within the per-run cap).
tooltips.calculations: Expression: numbers, references to numeric columns {field}, + - * /, parentheses, round(x, n). Division by zero gives an empty value.
tooltips.accessType: Private — owner and administrators; public — everyone with access to reports; shared — listed users and teams.
tooltips.charts: Up to three charts of a summary report. With the axis "group 1 → group 2" there is one chart: categories are the values of group 1, series the values of group 2 (of a matrix, its columns). Progress lines: the minimum, average and maximum of the values from the first category up to the current one.
tooltips.dashboard: Main filter: the field whose value is chosen in the header of the "Report" dashlet (an enum field or the owner of the main entity). Default mode: what a new dashlet shows, the chart or the table.
